name: Teleno Koinos Node
description: Community alternative powered by Teleno 1.3.0: one Koinos-compatible process instead of the legacy service stack. Native Linux x64 or one Docker container on x64 Windows/macOS/Linux. Separate encrypted wallet, observer/producer controls, native backups and logs. No Alpha database import, bridge funding or automatic reward reburning. Upstream ARM/Pi runtime unavailable.
